prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1046; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on a multi-lane roadway. Insured states the other vehicle drifted into their lane without signaling. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles received from insured.

Entry 2: Adverse party's carrier acknowledged liability investigation. Claimant reports neck and lower back pain and has been treated at urgent care. Claimant is now represented by counsel; all further contact to be routed through the attorney's office. Medical authorization requested from counsel.

Entry 3: Received recorded statement from insured, consistent with initial report. Witness identified in police report not yet reached. Left voicemail. Estimate for insured vehicle's right rear quarter panel and bumper reviewed; repair authorized at the direct repair facility.

Entry 4: Counsel's office provided initial treatment records showing a diagnosis of lumbar strain. Records indicate follow-up physical therapy has been recommended. Reviewing records for consistency with the reported mechanism of impact. Requested prior treatment history for the same body region.

Entry 5: Witness reached by phone and confirmed the other vehicle changed lanes into the insured's path. Liability assessment updated to favor insured. Counsel notified of preliminary findings. Injury claim remains open pending completion of physical therapy and receipt of final medical billing.
